`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The `ui.Warning` format uses `%q` (quoted string) for the container name — this makes names with spaces or special characters unambiguous to the operator, and the remediation command uses unquoted `%s` so it can be copy-pasted directly into the terminal.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

**Summary of change** (`internal/reconcile/compose.go:93-104`):

- Added `ui` import
- Added `ui.Warning("Container name conflict: ...")` header message before the loop
- Added `ui.Warning("  Conflicting container %q — remediation: docker rm -f %s", name, name)` per-container message inside the loop
- Kept all existing structured `logger.Error` / `logger.Info` calls untouched

Operators running `bosun reconcile` or watching daemon console output will now see a yellow warning with the exact `docker rm -f <name>` command when a project name mismatch causes a compose failure.
